awarding_body.value: National Board for Certification of School Nurses (NBCSN)

year_launched.note: Founding year of NBCSN credential not surfaced in primary sources reviewed.

eligibility.value: Hold a current, unrestricted RN license in the United States; hold a baccalaureate or higher degree (BSN or non-nursing bachelor's/master's accepted per NBCSN); and have completed a minimum of 1,000 hours of clinical practice in school nursing within the past three years (direct or indirect contributions to student health and education count).

exam_format.value: Computer-based exam delivered by PSI at testing sites across the U.S. (also offered via live online proctoring). Per project canonical certs.js, the exam contains 250 multiple-choice questions; per NBCSN public materials, the working count is 200 items (175 scored + 25 unscored pretest). Testing time is approximately 4 hours.

passing_score.value: Scaled score of 620 on a 200-800 scale (criterion-referenced).

fee_initial.value: $370 Early Bird application fee; $390 Regular application fee; $50 late fee if submitted after deadline.

pass_rate_recent.value: 70.6% in 2023 (847 passed of 1,199 examinations administered). Historical annual pass rates have ranged from approximately 50% to 83.6%.

renewal.value: 5-year certification cycle. Recertify by accumulating at least 75 contact hours of continuing education AND documenting at least 2,000 hours of school nursing clinical practice during the 5-year cycle (minimum 750 of those hours within the most recent 3 years), OR retake and pass the NCSN exam.

common_confusions.value: Often conflated with state-level school nurse certifications/endorsements issued by departments of education, which are separate licensing credentials and not the same as the national NCSN credential.

salary_context.note: BLS does not break out school nurses as a distinct OEWS occupation; salary varies widely by state education funding.

recent_changes.value: Effective Summer 2025 (July-August 2025 administration) the Exam Content Outline was restructured from five domains to four domains, with item counts per domain clarified.

blueprint.note: Fourth domain referenced in 4-domain restructure; specific item count not surfaced in summarized sources. Domain label paraphrased; consult Summer 2025 Candidate Handbook for verbatim.

discrepancies.resolution: Per skill rule, trust certs.js (250) on the page. Flagged here for user review.
